units.source_text: 有一个词叫“佯死态发作”。

en.t: There is a term called "thanatosis attack."

units.source_text: 一种昆虫，譬如像蜘蛛那种昆虫，冷不防受到攻击，便落入麻痹的状态。

en.t: A certain kind of insect, for example one like a spider, falls into a state of paralysis when suddenly attacked.

units.source_text: 被狂人占领了控制塔的飞机场。

en.t: An airfield whose control tower has been seized by a madman.

units.source_text: 冬眠中的青蛙，就像冬天不存在似的，它以为自己的静止也尽可能停止了世界上的动静。

en.t: A hibernating frog, as if winter did not exist, imagines that its own stillness has stopped the movements of the world as much as possible.
